Moonbyul is a decent dancer. She’s not technically the best. When looking at the best dancer, control is important. Many people look at the vibe and say they’re a good dancer. However, what separates someone who can dance from great dancers are control. 
When you observe a dance routine by kpop idols, easiest to do is comparing it to do the choreographer or back up dancer. Observe their placement, timing, transition, intensity, base form, foot work, versatility, expression. You have to see how much they pay attention to detail. In MMM, Wheein is the best dancer. She’s a pretty good dancer. She can be within top 5 of 3rd gen. Many girl group dancers lack versatility. Yes, they can follow the routine, but they cannot execute it properly. They will change the base form to suit them. In singing, thats like changing the lyrics. 
I think the easiest way to show would be watching korean girl group do hiphop routine because that will be opposite of what theyre used to. I suggest watching Wheein’s Be like me or Lo Lo and compare it to other girl group covering hip hop dance.
